hooks.command: read -r input_json; command_input=$(echo "$input_json" | jq -r '.input'); if [[ $command_input == "git commit"* ]]; then if [ ! -f "/tmp/ns3-dsw-tests-pass" ]; then echo "错误：测试未通过或未运行。在提交(git commit)之前，您必须首先运行 \`sh scratch/ns3-dsw/scripts/run-tests.sh\` 并确保它成功通过。" >&2; exit 2; else rm -f "/tmp/ns3-dsw-tests-pass"; exit 0; fi; fi; exit 0
